test_title: PYST 2: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - GA (Held On 25 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: gk
question: Which of the following statements is correct about India's performance at the Asian Athletics Championships 2025 in Gumi, South Korea?

options.text: India topped the medal tally with 24 medals, including nine golds.
Rupal Chaudhary won medals in both individual and team events, including a gold in the women's 5000m.
The Indian mixed relay team defended its title with only one member returning from the 2023 team.
Avinash Sable won silver in the 3000m steeplechase, ending a 36-year medal drought.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Indian mixed relay team defended its title with only one member returning from the 2023 team**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **26th Asian Athletics Championships 2025** was held in **Gumi**, **South Korea**, from **June 11 to 15, 2025**, featuring elite athletes from across the continent.
 
• **Statement A**: India concluded the championships with a total of **24 medals**, which included **9 gold**, **10 silver**, and **5 bronze**. However, India did not top the table; they finished in **3rd place** overall, while **China** secured the **1st position** with **13 gold medals**. *Hence, statement A is incorrect.*
 
• **Statement B**: **Rupal Chaudhary** was a standout performer, winning the **Gold medal** in the women's **400m** sprint and another **Gold** in the **mixed 4x400m relay**. The women's **5000m gold** was actually won by **Parul Chaudhary**. *Hence, statement B is incorrect.*
